display.purpose: Landing heading; local ramps serve account and paper entry.

body.purpose: Reading copy and inherited native-control text.

label.purpose: Persistent labels, legends, and text actions.

shadows.name: paper-object
shadows.purpose: Only the replaceable illustrative landing paper object.

motion.name: primary-hover
motion.purpose: Primary action background transition; removed with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: Stable account or navigation action with pending support.
components.css: .ds-primary { font-family: var(--font-body, 'DM Sans'), sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; display:inline-flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:2rem; min-height:52px; padding:.9rem 1.5rem; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:4px; background:var(--ink, #293744); color:white; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s; } .ds-primary:hover { background:#425363; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange, #b34322); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity:.65; cursor:wait; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-primary { transition:none; } }

components.name: Secondary action
components.description: Save-progress action alongside the primary action.
components.css: .ds-secondary { font-family: var(--font-body, 'DM Sans'), sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; background:transparent; color:var(--ink, #293744); border:1px solid var(--ink, #293744); border-radius:4px; padding:.9rem 1.25rem; min-height:52px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; } .ds-secondary:hover { background:#e7e0ee; } .ds-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange, #b34322); outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-secondary:disabled { opacity:.65; cursor:wait; }

components.name: Text field
components.description: Persistent label and connected help accompany a native field.
components.html: Enter an IANA time zone.
components.css: .ds-label { font-family: var(--font-body, 'DM Sans'), sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; display:block; color:var(--ink, #293744); font-weight:650; } .ds-help { font-family: var(--font-body, 'DM Sans'), sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; color:var(--muted, #535c65); font-size:.85rem; margin:.35rem 0 1rem; } .ds-field { font-family: var(--font-body, 'DM Sans'), sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; border:1px solid var(--control-line, #727780); border-radius:4px; padding:.7rem; background:transparent; color:var(--ink, #293744); width:100%; min-height:48px; caret-color:var(--orange, #b34322); } .ds-field::placeholder { color:var(--muted, #535c65); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange, #b34322); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Interest choice
components.description: Native checkbox inside a visible clickable label.
components.css: .ds-interest { font-family: var(--font-body, 'DM Sans'), sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.55rem; color:var(--ink, #293744); border:1px solid var(--control-line, #727780); border-radius:4px; padding:.65rem .8rem; cursor:pointer; } .ds-interest:has(:checked) { background:var(--lilac, #dcd2ee); border-color:var(--ink, #293744); } .ds-interest:hover { border-color:var(--ink, #293744); } .ds-interest input { width:17px; height:17px; margin:0; accent-color:var(--ink, #293744); } .ds-interest input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange, #b34322); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Masthead
components.description: Home identity and a persistent account action.
components.html: Herald.A little perspective, daily.Sign in
components.css: .ds-masthead { font-family: var(--font-body, 'DM Sans'), sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; min-height:100px; padding:1.4rem 5vw; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:2rem; color:var(--ink, #293744); border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink, #293744); } .ds-wordmark { font-family:var(--font-editorial, Fraunces),serif; font-size:2.65rem; font-weight:550; letter-spacing:-.035em; line-height:1.06; text-decoration:none; color:inherit; } .ds-wordmark span { color:var(--orange, #b34322); } .ds-masthead-note { flex:1; font-size:.85rem; color:var(--muted, #535c65); } .ds-text-link { margin-left:auto; color:inherit; font-weight:650; text-underline-offset:.25em; } .ds-masthead a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--orange, #b34322); outline-offset: 5px; } @media(max-width:760px) { .ds-masthead { min-height:82px; padding:1rem 6vw; } .ds-wordmark { font-size:2.2rem; } .ds-masthead-note { display:none; } }

components.name: Save notice
components.description: Visible and announced confirmation after saving progress.
components.html: Progress saved. You can pick up here after a reload.
components.css: .ds-notice { font-family: var(--font-body, 'DM Sans'), sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; font-size:.95rem; color:var(--ink, #293744); background:#e8e2f0; padding:1rem; border-radius:4px; }

components.name: Error notice
components.description: Announced failure with a recovery instruction; entered choices remain.
components.html: We couldn’t connect. Your choices are still here; please retry.
components.css: .ds-error { font-family: var(--font-body, 'DM Sans'), sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; font-size:.95rem; color:#782b19; background:#f5e0d7; padding:1rem; border-radius:4px; }

components.name: Illustrative paper object
components.description: Replaceable landing demonstration; never a real Edition.
components.html:
Herald.

A wider view. A little more you.
components.css: .ds-paper { font-family: var(--font-body, 'DM Sans'), sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; color:var(--ink, #293744); width:min(100%,330px); padding:1.75rem; background:var(--paper, #f7f5ef); transform:rotate(5deg); box-shadow:0 15px 35px #29374424; } .ds-paper-title { font-family:var(--font-editorial, Fraunces),serif; font-weight:550; font-size:2.7rem; letter-spacing:-.035em; line-height:1.06; } .ds-rule { border-top:1px solid var(--ink, #293744); margin:1.25rem 0; } @media(max-width:760px) { .ds-paper { width:280px; } }

narrative.overview:
Warm paper, slate text, lilac fields, and small orange accents carry the confirmed editorial direction. Landing uses Persuade; login combines Persuade in its introduction with Operate in its sign-in panel; onboarding uses Operate; paper entry uses Read. The current paper entry confirms saved preferences and explicitly states that no Edition is available yet.

Final human-made comic-style person artwork, user-provided animation direction, and visual finishing remain deferred to issue #9. Preserve replaceable illustration areas and stable account actions. No person asset, final composition, or entrance animation is approved.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial Fraunces headings paired with DM Sans reading and controls.
Paper surfaces, lilac introductory regions, and slate structure.
Native labeled controls with visible pending, recovery, and save states.
Calm paper-entry hierarchy without fabricated news.

rules.name: The Control Boundary Rule
rules.body: Use control-line for boundaries needed to identify editable or selectable controls. Keep line for decorative summary separators; the two roles are distinct.

dos: Do keep keyboard focus visible and preserve native control semantics.
Do use control-line for field and interest boundaries, and line for summary separators.
Do keep account actions usable while the illustration areas remain replaceable.
Do preserve error recovery, pending labels, and visible save confirmation.
donts: Don't introduce generated person artwork or treat unapproved examples as final assets.
Don't resolve final composition or motion ahead of the deferred issue #9 work.
Don't present an illustrative paper object or placeholder as a real Edition.
Don't apply the landing paper object's rotation and shadow to operational forms.
